brand.title: Earth Symphony
brand.subtitle: Multisensory Earth Jukebox
brand.aria: Earth Symphony, back to the maps

skip.tutorial: Start the audio tutorial, recommended for blind users

gallery.heading: Listen to the planet, pixel by pixel
gallery.lead: Pick a NASA map and explore it with the mouse or the keyboard. Each map is played by its own instrument: the higher the value, the higher the note. Click a place, or press Space, to hear the country and the value.
gallery.announce: Maps. {n} NASA maps. Use Tab to choose a map and Enter to open it.

symphony.hint: A bar sweeps the map from left to right and turns the data into music with a beginning, middle and end.

sweep.title: Symphony and walks
sweep.intro: Listen to the map without moving anything. In the symphony, a bar sweeps the image and composes music. In the walks, the cursor travels along a path.
sweep.recordHint: When it ends, the music becomes a WAV file to download (the voice is not recorded).

routeOptions.sinfonia: Map symphony (a bar sweeps the image)

sweep.cannotRecord: This browser cannot record the audio; it will play without recording.
sweep.recordFailed: Could not record the audio; it will play without recording.
sweep.introSymphony: Map symphony: a bar will sweep the map from left to right in {secs} seconds and turn each stretch into music, played by the {inst}. High notes come from the high values and low notes from the low values. The piece has an opening, development, climax and ending.
sweep.introVolta: Sound walk around the world{where}: {secs} seconds from west to east. With headphones, the sound travels from left to right.
sweep.introPolos: Sound walk from pole to pole{where}: {secs} seconds from north to south.
sweep.introMapa: Sound walk across the whole map: {rows} rows from top to bottom, in {secs} seconds.
sweep.introPlaces: Each place has its sound: waves at sea, insects and birds in the forest, dry wind in the desert, cold wind and crystals on ice, and a bell at borders.
sweep.introHeart: If you hear a heartbeat, it is {label}.
sweep.introStopSymphony: The arrow keys, a click on the map or {key} stop the music.
sweep.introStopWalk: The arrow keys, a click on the map or {key} stop the walk.
sweep.downloadReady: The audio is ready: use the Download audio button in the Symphony and walks panel.

phone.connected: Phone connected ✓ · move over the map
phone.noVibration: The connected phone cannot vibrate (e.g. iPhone). It will show visual pulses.

a11y.title: Accessibility
a11y.voiceHint: Speaks the place you click, notices, the legend and the tutorial. Turn it off if you use a screen reader.
a11y.readerHint: Reads each button and control aloud as you move with Tab.
a11y.readerOn: Built-in reader on: I will read each control as you move with Tab.
a11y.readerAfterTutorial: The built-in reader stays on: I will read each button as you move with Tab. Press {key} for every shortcut.

legend.title: Legend: {title}
legend.intro: On this map, the {inst} plays the {what}: the higher the value, the higher the note.
legend.howToHear: Hover over a card, or use Tab and Enter on the Listen buttons, to hear each sound. The voice pauses while the sound plays.
legend.placesIntro: The sounds of places, which play under the music.
legend.whenReady: When you are ready, press Start exploring at the end of the legend. {close} or a click outside closes it.

mar.name: Sea
mar.text: Waves coming and going: a low rumble and foam.

gelo.name: Ice
gelo.text: Cold whistling wind and high crystals. Poles, Greenland and extreme cold.

floresta.name: Forest
floresta.text: Insects trilling and birds singing in the notes of the scale.

deserto.name: Desert
deserto.text: Gusts of dry wind, fine sand and a low drone: vastness.

fronteira.name: Border
fronteira.text: A soft bell rings when the cursor crosses from one country into another.

coracao.name: Heartbeat
coracao.textAlert: Beats at the extreme values of this map ({label}), faster the more extreme.
coracao.textNone: Beats at extreme values (extreme heat, very warm sea, high pollution, storms). This map has no alert range.

shortcuts.idioma: switches the site language between English and Portuguese
shortcuts.voz: turns the site voice on or off
shortcuts.som: turns the sound on or pauses it
shortcuts.mapa: moves the focus to the map
shortcuts.galeria: goes back to the list of maps
shortcuts.lerLugar: says the country (or ocean) and the value of the map at the cursor. A click on the map does the same
shortcuts.visaoGeral: overview of the map, with the highest and lowest values and where they are
shortcuts.posicao: says the cursor position and its coordinates
shortcuts.centro: goes back to the center of the map
shortcuts.sinfonia: plays or stops the map symphony
shortcuts.escape: closes the open window (a click outside also works) or silences the voice
shortcuts.arrows: move the cursor. The voice tells you when you reach an edge
shortcuts.digits: jump to nine regions of the map, like a phone keypad: 1 is top left, 5 is the center and 9 is bottom right
shortcuts.scale: go through the color scale and play each value

help.title: Help and keyboard shortcuts
help.intro: Everything on this site works with the keyboard and sound alone. Every shortcut is a single key, with no Ctrl, Alt or Shift. Escape or a click outside closes this help.
help.how: Choose a map. Before exploring, the legend shows the map's scale and its instrument. On the map, a cursor travels across the planet: the higher the value of the place, the higher the note, and the position sets the side of the sound, left or right. Click on the map, or press {read}, to hear the country and the value.
help.sr: If you use NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver or TalkBack, turn off the site voice: everything it says also goes to the screen reader. On the map, the screen reader switches to focus mode by itself, and the keys above work directly.

tutorial.voiceHint: Turn it off if you already use a screen reader.
tutorial.skip: Skip and go to the maps
